source.how: Read from the Map 5.1 sheets as the hold file beside it (washington-plan-rule-unmeasured-lots.geojson) describes. Bull Mountain ASC 8 is the pink outline labelled 8, south of Fischer Road between Pacific Highway and 131st Avenue; the county's taxlots put 125 R-9 lots wholly inside, and the three it cuts (2S116D000200 R-9 0.77, 2S115CB00400 R-15 0.78, 2S115C000901 R-15 0.51) are carried whole by joining them to the outline, so every lot touching ASC 8 carries the review. Raleigh Hills - Garden Home's R-25+ site is the one R-25+ lot inside ASC L (taxlot 1S113BC00200, 4.02 acres), held as its lot shape. Chunk 8 and FOLLOWUPS 137 (2026-10-31): each review is held on lot shapes, whole. Metzger - Progress ASCs 2, 3 and 9 (Type III) and ASC 18 (an overall master plan agreed by half the owners first; the text puts it on the TO:R9-12 parcels north of Hall Boulevard, the third unnumbered outline there), a lot more than 10 percent inside; East Hillsboro ASC 3's three R-24 lots (General Design Element 15's site plan for the lot and its neighbours, 'strictly applied'); Sherwood ASC 2's one R-15 lot (design in light of the Tonquin - Elsner arterial, conditions 'may be placed'); FOLLOWUPS 137(b), the lots of the master planning - planned development ASCs of Sunset West (2, 3 and 7; ASCs 6 and 8 hold no lot the pod is allowed on) and Cedar Hills - Cedar Mill (2, 7 and 8); and FOLLOWUPS 137(a), in all ten plans with lots, every residential lot whose boundary runs at least 15 ft within 60 ft of a TSP Principal Arterial, Arterial or Collector centreline, since each plan's general design element makes shared or consolidated access a condition of a development permit on those roads. Zones: the residential districts the pod is allowed in (R-5 to R-25+, the North Bethany NB districts, TO:R9-12 to TO:R18-24).
